functional.scope: Actual ROM service + arbiter + FIFO fill + READ16 reader. CPU/PPU and slots are modeled; address-dependent 70ns PSRAM model, 16 clock phases, exact transcript equivalence. No whole core/game, metastability, physical fit or FPS approval.

conditional_io.scope: 1000ns IO exceptions expose data delay only; their slack is not a pass criterion. Mixed-clock groups are top100 samples per pair/corner, not complete CDC coverage. Digital conditional envelopes exclude unmeasured electrical behaviour, metastability and stopped-clock response deadlines.
